fixes: Closing or cancelling a filter picker restores the prior selection; Apply title commits title changes.
Older failed or successful requests cannot overwrite newer results or errors.
Export is disabled while changes are pending; export and query errors appear in the active drawer.
Reset clears stale errors and removes an obsolete shared-view hash.
Saved views validate real dates, time bounds and allowed fields before changing the current selection; corrupt saved storage is handled.
Picker background controls remain inert and keyboard focus stays in the active dialog, including during drawer animation.
The filter bar waits for metadata before accepting input; equivalent selection ordering does not create false pending changes.
Malformed API input returns a validation error; SQLite connections close deterministically.
Formatting and placeholder separators display correctly; failed drill-downs do not scroll to stale journeys.
ux_improvements: Visible loading, success and retry feedback, with a longer-wait message after four seconds.
Previous results protected from clicks while new results are loading.
Unapplied changes clearly labelled on More filters and its Apply action.
Explicit Cancel, clearer option counts and guarded Load more prevent ambiguous/repeated clicks.
Sticky controls and scroll offsets keep journey headings reachable.
Green heading hierarchy, readable text contrast, subtle shadows and stable hover targets.
Short landscape dialogs keep Cancel and Apply actions reachable.
Eight-view version-aware cache makes revisiting recent views faster.
